```text
# #4316: Patch: the 17.6 MB of voice lines download in the background only once a game is on screen, and not while the browser asks to save data
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Almost every card in JackiOh has a recorded voice line: 1,905 short sound files, about 17.6 MB in all. During a match the client downloads all of them in the background, so a card the opponent plays speaks the moment it lands. Since a change two days ago, that bulk download can also start on the home page, the sign-in page, the collection or any other menu after the player's first tap, whether or not they ever start a game. A new player who opens the site on a phone, taps Sign in and looks around their cards can spend 17.6 MB of mobile data on voices they never hear.

Once this is built, the bulk download waits until a game is actually on the screen, as it did before that change. A player whose browser asks sites to save data (Chrome's Lite mode or Data Saver) never gets the bulk download at all. The lines for the cards on their screen still load ahead as they do today, and any other line loads when it is spoken.

## Why

- Before #4158 (commit addbe49ae9, 2026-11-18), `schedulePrefetch()` had one caller: `preloadVoices`, which only a mounted board calls (`apps/web/src/audio/useGameAudio.ts:177`). #4158 made the sound tables lazy and added a second call when they arrive: `if (running()) schedulePrefetch();` in `onTablesLoaded` (`apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts:288`). That handler runs on whatever screen is open, whether or not a preload was asked for.
- Every page loads the tables. `main.tsx:975` holds `retainAppAudio()` for the page's lifetime (`audio/appAudio.ts`: the gesture unlock, the UI ticks and the menu theme). The menu theme builds the music player (`audio/musicScene.ts`, `apply`), which loads the tables (`audio/music.ts:173-176`), and the first gesture's `unlock()` loads them too. `loadSoundTables()` waits for the engine module first (`audio/soundTablesLoader.ts:38-60`). So on a cold load (a first visit, a slow phone, a new build), the first tap usually starts the audio context before the tables land. When they land, `running()` is true and the prefetch is scheduled on that menu.
- `schedulePrefetch()` (`engine.ts:742-751`) then fetches every key in the voice manifest after `VOICE_PREFETCH_DELAY_MS` (2 s), `VOICE_PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY` (2) at a time (`audio/constants.ts:45-46`). That is 1,905 files and 17,558,560 bytes (`audio/voice-manifest.json`), kept in memory for the page's lifetime (`engine.ts:312`). Voice is on and unmuted by default (`DEFAULT_AUDIO_SETTINGS`, `audio/settings.ts`).
- The docs still describe the old behaviour. B51 in `docs/polish/2-sound.md` (lines 409 and 971) starts the prefetch VOICE_PREFETCH_DELAY_MS *after the first preload* on a running context. The B51 test in `engine.test.ts` covers only that path, and no test checks that a screen without a board fetches no voice lines.
- The client already skips prefetching when the browser asks to save data (R2116000; `savingData()` in `routes/chunks.tsx:135-138`). The voice prefetch, by far the largest background download, ignores that signal, in a match too.
- #4130, #4180 and #4222 cut about 627 KB gzipped from the first page load between them (`net/first-load.test.ts`). This background download is many times larger. On a phone it competes for the connection with the engine module and the scene data that those issues moved and #4288 now prefetches.

## Proposal

1. Start the bulk prefetch only after a preload has been asked for, as before #4158. Either drop the schedule from `onTablesLoaded` (a preload held until the tables land already goes through `preloadVoices`, which schedules), or gate it on a flag that `preloadVoices` sets.
2. Skip the bulk prefetch while the browser asks to save data. The engine reads a `saveData` port, defaulting to `navigator.connection?.saveData === true`, as `savingData()` in `chunks.tsx` does (one shared helper). `schedulePrefetch` and `pumpPrefetch` start nothing while it holds. Two things stay as they are: the targeted preload of the lines for cards in view (`preloadVoices`, at most `VOICE_PRELOAD_MAX` per call), and the on-demand fetch of a line asked to play. The spec does not make this decision, so it gets a ruling note in the issue's block, its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, and a test named after it.
3. Rewrite B51 (and B58, where it names the prefetch) in `docs/polish/2-sound.md`, and the comment above `schedulePrefetch`, to say both.

## Where it lands

- `apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts`: `onTablesLoaded`, `schedulePrefetch`, `pumpPrefetch`, and a `saveData` option on `AudioEngineOptions`
- `apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts`: the B51 tests
- `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx`: `savingData()` moves to a shared helper, if the builder shares it
- `docs/polish/2-sound.md`: B51 and B58
- `spec/rulings/R<n>.md` and `spec/pending/<issue>.md`: the save-data rule, beside R2116000's. SPEC §10.11 is unchanged.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A unit test with the tables deferred, the context unlocked and running, then the tables resolved. Well past `VOICE_PREFETCH_DELAY_MS`, with no `preloadVoices` call, no voice URL has been fetched. This test fails on today's `main`.
- [ ] The existing B51 test still passes: after the first preload on a running context, every manifest line is fetched once, a few at a time.
- [ ] A test where a preload is asked for before the tables arrive: once they land, its lines are fetched and then the whole manifest.
- [ ] A test named after the new ruling, with the save-data port true. `preloadVoices` fetches only its own keys, and nothing else is fetched after the delay. With the port false, the next preload starts the bulk prefetch.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/audio/engine.test.ts src/routes/chunks.test.tsx`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, eslint and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.

## Size and risks

Small: a few lines in one module, four tests, two doc paragraphs and one ruling note. Difficulty medium. Nothing changes at a game's table for a player without save-data. With save-data on, an opponent's card whose line was never preloaded starts speaking once its file (about 9 KB on average) arrives, a moment later than a prefetched line would. That is the trade the player chose when they asked to save data. The fix restores what B51 already documents, so no existing test should need its expectation changed.

| File | New / change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts` | change | `AudioEngineOptions.saveData` port; `onTablesLoaded` drops its prefetch schedule; `schedulePrefetch`/`pumpPrefetch` honor save-data; comment above `schedulePrefetch` |
| `apps/web/src/net/saveData.ts` | new | Shared `savingData()` helper |
| `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx` | change | Local `savingData()` replaced by the shared helper |
| `apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts` | change | Three new tests plus one ruling-named test; existing B51/B58 tests untouched |
| `docs/polish/2-sound.md` | change | B51 paragraph (line 971) and the prefetch sentence of B58 (line 993) |
| `spec/rulings/R4316000.md` | new | The save-data ruling (lowest free number in issue 4316's block) |
| `spec/pending/4316.md` | new | The §11 paragraph for the ruling |

Must not touch: anything under `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, or `bot/`; `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md`, `spec/CARDS.md`; any file under `crates/`, `apps/edge/`, `apps/server/`, or `e2e/`. Governing spec: §10.11 (unchanged) and ruling R2116000 (beside the new note).

## Steps

1. Create `apps/web/src/net/saveData.ts` with one export, copying the exact check in `chunks.tsx`:
   `export function savingData(): boolean { return (navigator as SaveDataNavigator).connection?.saveData === true; }`
   including the `SaveDataNavigator` type moved from `chunks.tsx`. Guard for no `navigator` (jsdom/SSR) by returning false when `typeof navigator === "undefined"`.
2. In `apps/web/src/routes/chunks.tsx`, delete the local `SaveDataNavigator` type and `savingData()` (lines 134-139) and import `savingData` from `../net/saveData.ts`. No behavior change; the existing R2116000 tests must pass unmodified.
3. In `apps/web/src/audio/engine.ts`, add to `AudioEngineOptions` (after `visibility`, ~line 135):
   `saveData?: () => boolean; // default: shared savingData() (navigator.connection?.saveData); tests pass an explicit port`
   Default it inside `createAudioEngine` as `const saveData = options.saveData ?? savingData;` importing from `../net/saveData.ts`. A port (not a direct navigator read) keeps the engine testable and matches the existing `visibility` port pattern.
4. In `onTablesLoaded` (`engine.ts:272-294`), delete line 288 (`if (running()) schedulePrefetch();`). A preload held for the tables already replays through `preloadVoices` (lines 289-293), which schedules the prefetch itself when running (line 1077), so the held path keeps working. Rejected alternative: a `preloadRequested` flag gating the schedule in `onTablesLoaded`; it adds state for no extra case the held path does not already cover.
5. In `schedulePrefetch` (`engine.ts:743-751`), return early while save-data holds:
   `if (prefetchScheduled || loadedManifest === null || saveData()) return;`
   and inside the `later(VOICE_PREFETCH_DELAY_MS, …)` callback, re-check before filling `prefetchRest`:
   `if (loadedManifest === null || saveData()) return;`
   The double check matters: the port can flip during the 2 s delay. `prefetchScheduled` stays true (one schedule per engine lifetime, as today).
6. In `pumpPrefetch` (`engine.ts:726-740`), stop while save-data holds: change the loop to `while (prefetchInFlight < VOICE_PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY && !saveData() && backgroundFree())`. This also covers the resume paths (`applySettings` voice-on toggle, `setBusy(false)`), which all funnel through `pumpPrefetch`.
7. Rewrite the comment above `schedulePrefetch` (line 742) to:
   `/** After the first preload on a running context (never on tables landing alone, never while the browser asks to save data): every line's bytes, a few at a time, so no first line waits on the network. */`
8. Write `spec/rulings/R4316000.md` with front matter (`id: R4316000`, title naming save-data voice prefetch, `cards: "§10.11, R2116000, issue #4316"`, `proven_in: [apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts]`), ruling text: while `navigator.connection.saveData` is true the engine fetches no voice bytes except the targeted `preloadVoices` keys and the file of a line asked to play; rejected: prefetching anyway (the 17.6 MB bulk download is what the player asked to avoid). Follow Hearthstone semantics line: Hearthstone makes no save-data decision; this follows the browser signal per R2116000's precedent.
9. Write `spec/pending/4316.md` with one line in the style of `spec/pending/4285.md`:
   `**[[R4316000]] <title> (issue #4316, 2026-11-20):** …`
10. Rewrite B51 in `docs/polish/2-sound.md` (line 971) to start the prefetch `VOICE_PREFETCH_DELAY_MS` after the first preload on a running context (never when the tables land with no preload asked), and to skip it while the browser asks to save data; adjust the prefetch sentence of B58 (line 993) to match. Touch no other paragraph.
11. Add the tests in `apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts` (see Tests). Copy the B51 hang/release/elapse pattern (lines 1211-1230) and the #4130 deferred-tables pattern (lines 1958-1977).

## Tests

All in `apps/web/src/audio/engine.test.ts`, in the `describe("B51 caches and prefetch")` block (or a adjacent `describe("R4316000 …")` for the ruling one):

- `it("no preload asked: tables landing on a running context fetch no voice bytes", …)`: `deferSoundTablesForTests()`, `rig({ engine: { lines: undefined, manifest: undefined } })`, `unlocked(r)`, assert state is running, resolve tables with `{ cardAudio: LINES, voiceManifest: PRELOAD_MANIFEST, … }`, `await elapse(r, VOICE_PREFETCH_DELAY_MS + 5_000)`, expect `r.fetch.fetchBytes` not called. Fails on today's `main` (line 288 schedules the prefetch).
- Existing B51 tests (`engine.test.ts:1188-1240`) keep passing unmodified.
- `it("#4316 a preload asked for before the tables arrive fetches its lines, then the whole manifest", …)`: deferred tables, unlocked running rig with `lines: undefined, manifest: undefined`, `r.engine.preloadVoices(["core-004-play"])`, resolve tables, `await settle()`, expect `core-004-play` fetched; `await elapse(r, VOICE_PREFETCH_DELAY_MS)` plus drain loop (copy lines 1222-1225), expect every `PRELOAD_MANIFEST` key fetched exactly once.
- `it("R4316000 while the save-data port holds, preloadVoices fetches only its own keys and nothing else follows", …)`: `rig({ engine: { manifest: PRELOAD_MANIFEST, saveData: () => true } })`, unlocked, `preloadVoices(["core-004-play"])`, `await elapse(r, VOICE_PREFETCH_DELAY_MS + 5_000)`, expect fetched URLs equal `[url("core-004-play")]`; then a second engine with `saveData: () => false` where the next `preloadVoices` starts the bulk prefetch (expect `1 + VOICE_PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY` URLs after the delay, copy lines 1220-1221).

Commands: the two vitest files, the web typecheck, eslint on the touched files, and the spec check (name-only per instructions): the engine and chunks test files, typecheck, eslint, and `cargo jackioh spec check`. Also `cargo fmt --check` (no Rust changes, must stay clean).

## Done when

- [ ] Tables landing with no preload fetch nothing; existing B51 passes; held preload fetches its lines then the manifest; R4316000 save-data test passes.
- [ ] `chunks.test.tsx` passes unmodified (shared helper is behavior-identical).
- [ ] Typecheck, eslint, and the rulings check pass.
- [ ] Ruling note, pending paragraph, and B51/B58 doc rewrites are in place; §10.11 untouched.

## Risks

- A preload asked while suspended schedules no prefetch until the next `preloadVoices` call (next view change replays it via `useGameAudio`). Same as today's behavior for that path; the new tests pin the deferred-tables path explicitly.
- `saveData()` is read at schedule, due-time, and pump time, so a mid-delay flip either way is honored; the port default reads the live navigator value on each call, never a cached one.
- No hidden-information or rule impact: the client still only preloads keys for cards in view, and playback paths are untouched (CLAUDE.md rule 7).

## Open questions

None. The one judgment call the task left (drop the `onTablesLoaded` schedule vs. flag-gate it) is settled in step 4.
